reason: The pack only says "no pork ingredients", and that is not the same as halal-certified, so I will not bring it into my house. On top of that it costs RM 2.80 against the RM 2 I pay for Whiskas with my weekly groceries, and my cat eats Whiskas without any fuss.
objection: No pork does not mean halal. I see no JAKIM or other recognised halal logo, and it is a new brand I have never heard of, so I do not know what else is in it or where it is made.
would_change_my_mind: A recognised halal certification logo on the pack (JAKIM or one JAKIM recognises), and a price close to RM 2 at a shop where I already do my groceries, not ordering by Facebook message.
